text:
alex: postdeploy small-batch readiness check failing in eu-west1, noticed p95 spike on tiny payloads after canary. any eyes?

deploy-bot: canary-smoke: eu-west1 canary finished. basic health checks OK. synth probe 'small-batch-readiness' failed 6/10.

sam: https://dash.internal/runs/17654 - p95 jump visible on the small-payload probe, looks correlated with recent batcher tweak.

lydia: looking at traces — batcher queueing increases when requests per-batch <= 3. saw KV cache miss rate go from 2% -> 12% during the spike. config shows `batch_window_ms=6` briefly spiking to ~40ms.

qa-engineer: reproduced locally with production samples: `tools/replay --sample small --target eu-west1` -> p95 ~380ms vs baseline ~120ms. stack shows waiting in batcher scheduling slot.

infra-bot: infra-alert: autoscaler normal, no host OOMs, network retries 0. CPU and memory within expected.

sam: hypothesis: rollout included a cost-optimizing batcher change that reduces max wait for large batches but increases latency for tiny requests due to stricter cutoff.

alex: propose: hold rollout for eu-west1, pin traffic back to previous variant v4.2.1, and patch batcher to lower min_window for small payload paths. any objections?

lydia: :thumbsup: from me. I'll prepare a hotfix to adjust `min_window_ms` gating and run a targeted synthetic against tiny payloads.

qa-engineer: I'll re-run `tools/replay` after the patch and post results in ~15m.

deploy-bot: action: hold rollout eu-west1 (deployment id d-9831), pinned to v4.2.1. Flagging release window and owners.

alex: thanks — logging follow-up INF-2345 to track root cause and config perf test. pinging @oncall if we see regression after patch.
